title: Midnight Window
description: Twenty minutes by a rain-streaked window. The soft bells and D-minor melody from Apartment’s title screen, extended into a slow, uninterrupted escape.

story.title: One light left on
story.text: The city falls quiet. Your window stays awake.

story.title: A visitor in the rain
story.text: A small golden light finds its way to the glass.

story.title: Somewhere to go
story.text: You open the window. The night opens with it.

story.title: Follow the light
story.text: Across the rooftops, a thousand other stories glow.

title: Last Train Home
description: Low electric keys, a soft drum machine, and a bass line going somewhere. A warm lo-fi ride from the neon city to open countryside.

story.title: The last departure
story.text: One passenger. One ticket. A city slipping away.

story.title: Neon becomes memory
story.text: The windows collect places you almost called home.

story.title: Beyond the city
story.text: Buildings turn to hills. There is room to breathe.

story.title: A light in the distance
story.text: Somewhere ahead, someone has left a light on.

title: Paper Satellites
description: Low, rounded keys float through a cloud of warm synths. Fold a little wish, send it into orbit, and let this soft lo-fi daydream carry it.

story.title: A wish, folded twice
story.text: You fold the thing you cannot say into a paper plane.

story.title: Leaving gravity
story.text: It climbs past the clouds. Even worries look small here.

story.title: An unlikely constellation
story.text: Other wishes arrive. None of them are flying alone.

story.title: Return address: the sky
story.text: The universe sends a little light back.

title: The Blue Between
description: Mellow low-register keys and a tide of warm chords. A tiny boat, a patient lighthouse, and a slow lo-fi drift with nowhere to hurry.

story.title: The shore lets go
story.text: A little boat carries the last of the night out to sea.

story.title: The blue between
story.text: There is no road here. Only the rhythm of the water.

story.title: A patient lighthouse
story.text: A light turns, again and again. You are still on course.

story.title: Nothing is lost
story.text: The tide brings you somewhere you have never been.

title: First Light
description: Warm low keys, a gentle beat, and a melody that takes its time. A soft lo-fi sunrise, with the rooftop all to yourself.

story.title: Before everyone else
story.text: You take the stairs to the roof. The sky is waiting.

story.title: The first gold
story.text: A thin line of light finds the edges of everything.

story.title: The city exhales
story.text: Windows catch the sun. Somewhere, the first kettle sings.

story.title: A new beginning
story.text: Nothing has to happen yet. This morning is enough.

title: Room for Thought
description: A low note, a soft chord, and plenty of room between them. Quiet furniture music for reading, working, or letting your thoughts wander.

story.title: A room, unhurried
story.text: The room asks nothing of you.

story.title: A page left open
story.text: There is time for another sentence.

story.title: Light on the wall
story.text: The afternoon moves at its own pace.

story.title: Room for thought
story.text: Stay with whatever you are doing. The music will keep you company.

title: The Quiet Margin
description: Rounded piano-like chords repeat softly beside an imagined garden. No drums, no lead melody, no sudden changes: just a little quiet at the edge of the day.
coverNote: IN THE MARGIN / LEAVE A LITTLE SPACE

story.title: At the edge of the day
story.text: A garden goes on growing, without an audience.

story.title: Nothing to catch
story.text: A leaf moves. You need not look up.

story.title: The quiet margin
story.text: Leave a little space around the things that matter.

story.title: Still here
story.text: The world can be gentle in small ways.

title: Nothing to Finish
description: Slow, low-register chords with soft attacks and long pauses. An unobtrusive companion with no climax to wait for and nothing asking for your attention.
coverNote: AN OPEN WINDOW / A LITTLE MORE TIME

story.title: An open window
story.text: The curtain moves. The room breathes.

story.title: A little more time
story.text: Nothing here needs to be completed.

story.title: No destination
story.text: Let the next thought arrive when it is ready.

story.title: Nothing to finish
story.text: You can leave the music in the background. It understands.
